title: DetectionBatch
description: QoS 1 on agri/v1/{robot_id}/detections, one message per analysed frame. Never dropped under backpressure and deduplicated on (robot_id, seq), because a lost detection is a plant nobody inspects. Boxes are normalised to the frame so they land correctly on either video path.

frame_id.description: Ties this batch to a video frame so the UI can align boxes, or dim them when no matching frame arrived.

run_id.description: Scouting run this frame belongs to; null when driving manually outside a run.

image_key.description: Object-store key of the full annotated frame. Null until the upload completes; the detection row is written either way.

plants_scanned.description: Plants seen in this frame, flagged or not. Summed to give the infection rate.

detection_id.description: Generated on the robot so a redelivered QoS 1 message cannot create a duplicate row.

issue_code.description: Key into issue_catalog, which holds the plain-language name, the type, what it is and what to do.

metres_from_edge.description: Distance along the row from the field edge. This is how a farmer actually walks to the plant.

crop_key.description: Object-store key of the cropped sample image shown in the Analytics hotspot detail.
